info.title: Ext Hello API
info.description:
RPC API of the Ext Hello extension (`ext_hello`) for OpenGunstore: Says hello to a customer from the POS. A starting point for an extension, not a feature.

All endpoints are Frappe *whitelisted methods* invoked as `/api/method/<dotted.path>` on a POS that has the extension installed. Unless an endpoint declares explicit HTTP verbs, it is documented here as POST. Arguments may be sent as JSON body, form data, or query string — JSON body is recommended.

Every operation carries an **Auth (derived from code)** line statically resolved from the gate the function actually executes. While the store has the extension switched off (Settings → Extensions), every gated endpoint refuses with a permission error.

The extension's DocTypes are served by Frappe's REST layer (`/api/resource/<DocType>`) — see the POS core's docs/api/frappe-rest.md; they are modelled under components.schemas and listed in reference/doctypes.md.

servers.description: local dev bench with the extension installed (safe default)

FrappeError.description: Frappe error envelope. HTTP 4xx/5xx with JSON body: `exc_type`, `exception`, `_server_messages` (JSON-encoded list of user-facing messages).
